label: Rival: whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 is material, and something is ALTOGETHER_IMMATERIAL_2
paraphrase: Rival framework commitment, unattributed, motivated by physicalism about the mind together with realism about immaterial things (abstract objects, or an impersonal first principle beyond intellect): whatever has intellect is composed of matter and form, and something is neither composed of matter and form nor a component of anything. The replacement account of why a thing knows is material organization, not separation from matter. Strictly stronger than the negation of STMT-IMMATERIAL-IS-INTELLECTUAL, which needs only one altogether immaterial thing without intellect. It does not deny that there are immaterial things or that there are intellects.
